Pre-construction: federal approval and construction authorisation held, financing (a C$115m bank-backed package was reported) not closed; analysts moved expected start to 2027 (R29) -> ref year 2027 (analyst expectation, not company guidance). capacity_norm 28,700 t LCE = 157,706 x 5.56% x 2.473 (21,684) + 46,059 x 6.16% x 2.473 (7,017), computed by me from the stated grades. 2022 FS had higher averages (173,317 + 51,369 t) - superseded. Hydroxide plant not committed (company says it cannot confirm). Date of the FS announcement taken from the search summary (29 Aug 2023); 2026 status not independently updated.

fields.asset_name: Uyuni DLE lithium carbonate plant (YLB - Uranium One)
fields.operator: YLB (Yacimientos de Litio Bolivianos) with Uranium One Group (Rosatom)

rows.notes: Contract signed Sep 2024: plant for 14,000 t/y Li2CO3, investment ~US$970m (R17). Still lacks congressional approval in 2026 (R16); a Bolivian court barred YLB and the ministry from administrative/operational steps under the contracts pending the judicial process (Mining.com, search summary, date unconfirmed). The new government (Pres. Paz) proposes a lithium law and an international tender. No construction. capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication-year FALLBACK - UNDATED; project_state paused = legally blocked. Province Potosi is the location of Uyuni (general knowledge).
